title: Kenmotsu Contact Geometry Through the Lens of $\ast-\boldsymbolκ$-Ricci-Bourguignon Almost Solitons
summary: This paper focuses on the study of the newly introduced $\ast-\boldsymbolκ$-Ricci-Bourguignon almost soliton pertaining to Kenmotsu structure manifolds. Our analysis concerns the characteristics of this soliton and derive the scalar curvature for a Kenmotsu manifold admitting such a structure. Further, we formulate the corresponding vector fields under the assumption that the manifold supports a $\ast-\boldsymbolκ-$Ricci-Bourguignon soliton.
